title: SignVerse-2M: A Two-Million-Clip Pose-Native Universe of 55+ Sign Languages
abstract: arXiv:2605.01720v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large-scale sign language resources usually pair RGB videos with text and support recognition, translation, and generation. However, RGB frames contain backgrounds, clothing, and other appearance information unrelated to signing motion. Representing the videos as whole-body keypoints such as DWPose removes much of this variation, produces a compact description of body, hand, and facial movement, and matches the input used by recent pose-guided video models. Existing datasets do not provide this representation at scale for in-the-wild sign language videos. We present SignVerse-2M, a multilingual dataset containing approximately two million pose clips from more than 55 sign languages. We process publicly available sign language videos with a shared DWPose pipeline, representing body, hand, and facial motion in the same keypoint format across all clips. translated_title: SignVerse-2M：涵盖55多种手语的两百万片段姿态原生数据宇宙
translated_abstract: 大规模手语资源通常将RGB视频与文本配对，以支持识别、翻译和生成任务。然而，RGB帧中包含背景、服装以及其他与手语动作无关的外观信息。将视频表示为DWPose等全身关键点可以消除大部分此类变化，生成对身体、手部和面部动作的紧凑描述，并与近期姿态引导视频模型所使用的输入格式相匹配。现有数据集并未针对真实场景中的手语视频大规模提供这种表示。我们提出了SignVerse-2M，这是一个多语言数据集，包含来自55多种手语的约两百万个姿态片段。我们使用统一的DWPose流程处理公开可用的手语视频，以相同的关键点格式表示所有片段中的身体、手部和面部动作。源视频包含多样化的手语使用者、视角和录制环境。
tldr: 本文提出SignVerse-2M，一个涵盖55多种手语、包含约两百万个统一DWPose关键点姿态片段的多语言数据集，填补了真实场景手语视频大规模姿态表示的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SignVerse-2M, a multilingual dataset of approximately two million pose clips with unified DWPose keypoint representations spanning 55+ sign languages, filling the gap of large-scale pose-native representations for in-the-wild sign language videos.
